title: Pure Motion Dance Company
specs: Year End Showcase at Jubilee Auditorium
Wide range of dance styles and age groups
blurb: PMDC offers diverse dance programs for ages 6 months and up, including specialized classes like Acro, Ballet, Hip Hop, Jazz, and Aerial Silks. They provide performance opportunities such as an annual Year End Showcase at the Jubilee Auditorium. The studio also offers summer camps, birthday parties, and leadership programs.
extraNote: Free trial classes available September to November · Students can opt out of Year End Showcase · September to June classes over a 10 month period
